title: The E×CM component of Zilber–Pink for curves in A2
summary: We prove the $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ component of Zilber–Pink for Hodge-generic algebraic curves in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$. Each such curve contains only finitely many points whose abelian surface is isogenous to a product of elliptic curves with at least one factor having complex multiplication.
family_title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold

review.reason: Proves finiteness of special points on Hodge-generic curves in A2, a clearly mathematical result.
